chapter: With the Goldkette band: Bix and Trumbauer
title: Hearing Bix's piece that became In a Mist
summary: Trumbauer and Bix played the unfinished piece, and Challis felt the musicians were far above him.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Bix Beiderbecke: hearing, copying and remembering him

blocks.x: "Well, we don't have our numbers picked out yet so just take it easy as much as you can and do whatever you want." It was about two weeks that we would get to the Roseland. So I got acquainted with the guys, that is, Trumbauer and Bix played
over his "In a Mist." It wasn't In a Mist then. Ludwig said, "Get him to play that thing for you, and it turned out to be In a Mist later."
He didn't have a title for it then.

Didn't have a title for it. Didn't have it finished. So I went out on the job to hear the band and all the time, I was knocked out. I wouldn't say knocked out, but I was highly impressed. I realized that these guys were way above me. I couldn't figure out what to do.
